flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, SSE-streamed answer

steps.note: No session snapshot needed — anonymous chat. duckduckgo.com/?ia=chat redirects here (302). If the DDG account onboarding modal appears, click through (dismiss selector).
jittered 600-1300ms human dwell; New Chat button (DUCKCHAT_NEW_CHAT_BUTTON); selector unverified
trusted keyboard.insertText into composer (textarea or contenteditable). Selector unverified — confirm on first live capture.
answer selector UNVERIFIED — SSE stream delivers text via JSON frames with action:success, role:assistant. The DOM rendering class is module-hashed; confirm on first live capture.

rpc: underlying wire = POST /duckchat/v1/chat (SSE, text/event-stream; frames: JSON {action:success/error} + markers [PING]/[DONE]/[CHAT_TITLE]/[FIXED_COST_WINDOW_USAGE]/[STOP_REASON]/[LIMIT_*]/[ADS:{windowID}]/[SUMMARY_*]). VQD token obtained from GET /duckchat/v1/status (x-vqd-accept:1) and refreshed per-response. Request body: {model, messages[{role,content[{type,text|image,file}]}], metadata{toolChoice}, reasoningEffort, canUseWebSearch, canUploadFiles, ...}. Auth: anonymous (VQD token from status header); DDG account optional (internal_duckchat_user cookie). The UI path drives the site's own JS so no VQD token extraction needed.
stealth: real session (anonymous — no capture needed), trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing; VQD token obtained by the app at runtime
